propositions: Apply --filter=blob:none to all CI tickets-branch fetch operations to reduce transfer size from 1+ GiB to ~68 MiB in standalone checkouts and from 6.73 minutes to <5 minutes in Gerrit verify-identity jobs.
Add filter: blob:none to actions/checkout@v7 steps in reconcile-bridge, verify-identity, and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows while preserving fetch-depth: 0 and existing credential/ref settings.
Explicitly pass --filter=blob:none to direct-URL git fetch commands in gerrit-verify.yaml, retaining --depth=1 for require-ticket fetch and no depth for full-history verify-identity fetch.

Establish production pack-size guardrails that fail if unfiltered all-history checkout exceeds 102400 KiB or Gerrit materialized pack exceeds 131072 KiB, validated by parsing git count-objects output.

Configure a real-Git daemon fixture with filter capability support and packet-trace oracle to verify protocol negotiation sends filter blob:none and leaves known blobs missing across named-origin and direct-URL fetch paths.
Ensure standalone and Gerrit verify-identity jobs leave git count-objects output unchanged post-materialization, proving no promisor-fetch side effects occur during identity scanning.
